fields.label: Story Paragraph 1
fields.name: about_story_p1
fields.default_value: Frignani’s was born from a deep love of Italian culture — its food, its wine, its craftsmanship, and the people behind it all. At the heart of our story is a tribute to Sabrina Frignani's grandmother, whose passion for Italian tradition and her belief in the power of sharing it with the world became the founding spirit of this house.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 2
fields.name: about_story_p2
fields.default_value: Her kitchen was a place of ceremony — where ingredients mattered, where provenance was everything, and where the table was always set for anyone who appreciated quality. That spirit is what we carry into every transaction, every partnership, every shipment.

fields.label: Story Paragraph 3
fields.name: about_story_p3
fields.default_value: Today, Frignani’s operates as a direct import & export house, connecting Italy’s finest producers — in wine, food, and luxury lifestyle — with international professionals who share our standards. We are not brokers of anonymous goods. We are custodians of a living heritage.

fields.label: Tribute Quote
fields.name: about_tribute_quote
fields.default_value: She believed that the finest things in life were meant to be shared — not kept, not hoarded, but given generously to those who truly appreciate them.

fields.label: Tribute Body Text
fields.name: about_tribute_body
fields.default_value: This house exists in honour of that belief. Every category we curate, every producer we partner with, every order we fulfill — it is all done in the spirit of Sabrina's grandmother, who showed us that Italian excellence is not a commodity, but a culture worth protecting and sharing with the world.

fields.label: Value 1 Description
fields.name: about_val1_desc
fields.default_value: We know the origin of every product we export. Provenance is not a marketing term for us — it is a contractual standard.

fields.label: Value 2 Description
fields.name: about_val2_desc
fields.default_value: We operate through direct import & export transactions. No intermediaries. No anonymous supply chains. A clear line from producer to buyer.

fields.label: Value 3 Description
fields.name: about_val3_desc
fields.default_value: Italian culinary culture is a living heritage. We exist to promote it, protect it, and share it with the world's most discerning professionals.
